subject.title: fix: harden small runtime and installer edge cases

question: Should this batch land with the stricter installer rule that requires real Arch detection before using pacman?
rationale: The code change fixes Debian false positives but intentionally removes a fallback that could have helped os-release-less Arch-like systems, so maintainer acceptance is needed before merge.

options.title: Land with stricter Arch detection
options.body: Accept the safer Debian behavior and let ambiguous pacman-only environments use the non-Arch path or manual setup.

options.title: Add a narrow Arch fallback first
options.body: Preserve os-release-less Arch support by adding a specific marker-based fallback and focused installer tests before merge.

options.title: Pause the batch
options.body: Keep the PR open until installer ownership decides whether this compatibility tradeoff belongs in the batch.

recommendation.title: Land with stricter Arch detection
recommendation.body: Accept the safer Debian behavior and let ambiguous pacman-only environments use the non-Arch path or manual setup.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the maintainer rebuild and supplied the land-ready proof for this batch.
